findings.issue: The R930/R931 positives never checked allocated(x) or the SOURCE= value; dropping SOURCE= or ERRMSG= still passed on both compilers.
findings.resolution: Now assert allocated(x), x == 37 from scalar SOURCE=, STAT == 0, and a distinguished non-blank ERRMSG unchanged on success (9.7.5 p2).

findings.issue: C944 and C949 were discharged by positives whose only mutations did not reach those constraints (removing the ALLOCATE; changing a length).
The new C944 negative allocate(x(1)) on a scalar ALSO violates C946 (shape-spec count must equal the rank, and a scalar has rank 0).
findings.resolution: Withdrawn: ANY shape-spec list on a scalar violates C946 too, so no C944-only negative exists. Unlike batch153's C1224 case, the overlapping rule is itself NUMBERED, so the negative cannot be attributed to C944 alone. scalar-shape-spec-rejected stays pending with that reasoning.

cases.R930 options: scalar SOURCE= value not transferred (x /= 37) - distinct from the batch128 shaped SOURCE=/MOLD= defect
cases.C949 type-spec with SOURCE=: accepted; the constraint requires a diagnosis
